description: This Java class 'MessageFactory' constructs 'MessageV1' objects used for external messaging within the Fineract system. It provides methods to create messages from various input data and external events, utilizing helper functions for date formatting and thread-local context for tenant identification.

classes.name: MessageFactory
classes.description: A Spring component responsible for creating 'MessageV1' instances used to communicate external events, encapsulating message construction logic including timestamp formatting and context retrieval.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a 'MessageV1' object from individual message components.

methods.name: createMessage
methods.description: Constructs a 'MessageV1' object from an 'ExternalEventView' instance, extracting and converting its fields.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the current tenant identifier from thread-local context.

methods.name: getMessageCreatedAt
methods.description: Formats an OffsetDateTime into a custom ISO-formatted string in UTC.

methods.name: getMessageBusinessDate
methods.description: Formats a LocalDate into an ISO string.

methods.name: afterPropertiesSet
methods.description: Logs the initialization of the message source UUID after bean properties are set.
